chapter.heading: A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Unto thee,
O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

Hear the
voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

Draw me
not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.

Give them
according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.

Because they
regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.

Blessed be
Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

Jehovah is
my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.

Jehovah is
their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

Save thy
people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.
